notes:
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-14: Search supports tag:name rather than the required #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: The parser only applies implicit AND and minus-prefix negation; AND/OR/NOT operators and parenthesised groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-21: Select All acts only on the currently loaded result set, capped at 500, rather than the entire filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written but are displayed as escaped plain text, not rendered Markdown.
REF-BM-24: HTML is captured without self-contained resources, and PDF URLs are not downloaded and stored as PDFs.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-32: Several display preferences and default sorting exist, but font-size and displayed-item-count settings are missing.
